AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  SEPTEMBER 14, 2022
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS PLANNING COMMISSION MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A
REMOTE LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: planning@norwalkca.gov OR JOIN
THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING 1-(408) 638-0968 OR USING THE ZOOM APP; MEETING ID: 895 8662
1054 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS
CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-
hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS

  AND VIA TELECONFERENCE
  Rosa Barragan, Chair
  Linda Lopez, Vice Chair
  Kim Apodaca, Planning Commissioner
  Gabriel P. Garcia, Planning Commissioner
  Luis Navas, Planning Commissioner
  Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address Planning Commission on any matter listed on the agenda or on any
  other matter within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal
  Code. If you wish to address Planning Commission, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to
  Council Chambers and hand the card to the Secretary. Planning Commission will hear public comment on items listed on
  the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. Planning Commission will hear public comment on matters
  not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule
  certain matters for consideration at a future Planning Commission meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Planning Commission:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the Planning Commission as a whole and not directed to individual Planning
  Commission members.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the Secretary's office, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda
  after it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e?mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
 Notice of Special Meeting

1.  MEETING MINUTES - Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the minutes of the
  Special Meeting of July 27, 2022.

  Minutes

PUBLIC HEARING

2.  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 184
  ZONE CHANGE NO. 363
  ZONING TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2022-01
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 2022-01
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 2022-01
  David Abasta, Primestor Development, Inc. ("Applicant") a request to establish a specific plan to
  allow a mixed-use development with up to 110,000 square feet of commercial uses, 350 residential
  units, with a minimum 15% developed as "affordable", and 100,000 square feet (2.3 acres) of open
  space. The project site consists of approximately 13.2 acres at the sout heast corner of Imperial
  Highway and Norwalk Boulevard (Assessor’s Parcel Numbers (APN) 8047-006-922, -924, -925, and a
  portion of APN 8047-006-927) and includes the City Hall Lawn and surface parking lot. The project
  includes a request for:

  (1) General Plan Amendment No. 184 to amend the General Plan to create a Mixed Use land use
  designation and change the land use designation of the project site from Institutional (I) to Mixed
  Use (MU);

  (2) Zone Change No. 363 to amend the zoning designation from Institutional (I) to Specific Plan 16
  (SPA 16) and remove the project site from the Public Facilities Overlay;

  (3) Zoning Text Amendment No. 2022-01 to establish the Norwalk Entertainment District - Civic
  Center Specific Plan including development standards for open space, residential, and commercial
  uses, for the subject site;

  (4) Conditional Use Permit No. 2022-01 to permit the sales and consumption of alcohol for
  commercial businesses within the development; and

  (5) Development Agreement No. 2022-01 between the City and Primestor Development, Inc. to vest
  the project approvals and specify the term of the land lease.

  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission

  (1) Adopt Resolution No. 22-07 recommending City Council approval of General Plan
  Amendment No. 184;

  (2) Adopt Resolution No. 22-08 recommending City Council approval of Zone Change No. 363;
  and

  (3) Adopt Resolution No. 22-09 recommending City Council approval of Zoning Text Amendment
  No. 2022-01, certification of the Final Environmental Impact Report, and a Mitigation Monitoring
  and Reporting Program; and

  (4) Adopt Resolution No. 22-10 recommending City Council approval of an Ordinance approving
  Development Agreement No. 2022-01.

  (5) Adopt Resolution No. 22-11 recommending City Council approval of Conditional Use Permit
  No. 2022-01, subject to the Conditions of Approval contained in attached respective Exhibit "A".

  Staff Report 9-14-22

  Attachment A - Resolution No. 22-07

  Attachment B - Resolution No. 22-08

  Attachment C- Resolution No. 22-09
   Attachment D - Resolution No. 22-10

  Attachment E - Resolution No. 22-11

  Attachment F - Location & Vicinity Map

  Attachment G - Draft Environmental Impact Report

  Attachment H - Mitigation Monitoring & Reporting Porgram

  Attachment I - Draft City Council Ordinance approving DA

  Attachment J - Draft City Council Ordinance adopting ZTA

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated September 9, 2022.

John P. Ramirez, AICP
Director of Community Development/Secretary
